best_idea: Keep XP as one running total, derive the next threshold from a band-based cumulative curve, and only apply level-ups between fights (the level check waits while a live enemy is within 8 units), rolling points and HP once per level gained.
decision_why: Frankendom keeps one XP ledger and one curve per class, but takes the shape of the banded cumulative cap and the presence-gated, batched level-up; the donor's HP-after-popup timing and its exe-table values are not taken.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a kill which leaves an enemy within 8 units defers the level-up, that clearing that enemy applies every level earned in one pass with one 4-6 point roll per level, and that a second hit on a dying enemy adds no XP.
